>
> Many thanks in advance,
>
> Johannes

messages.subject: Re: Rook - the "custom" prefix
messages.body_plain:
Sure! Deploy your Rook apps on rApache and you can use whatever URL
prefix you like:

http://jeffreyhorner.tumblr.com/post/27861973339/deploy-rook-apps-with-rapache-part-i

Sadly, you can't get rid of /custom when using Rhttpd.

Jeff
